## Cystic fibrosis

::: {.callout-note}
### Information

**Level:** Intermediate  
**External libraries:** None  
**Time:** Long
:::

Parse and translate DNA sequences to find patients with Cystic fibrosis. Can also be done with Biopython. Find the exercise [here](long_exercises/CF_exercise.qmd)



## Snakemake workflow

::: {.callout-note}
### Information

**Level:** Advanced  
**External libraries:** Snakemake, bcftools, scipy, pandas, matplotlib  
**Time:** Long
:::

Use Snakemake to build a workflow for getting VCFs, extracting data, calculate SNP frequencies and plot results. Find the exercise [here](long_exercises/snakemake_plotting.qmd)
